definitions:
All history-matching / monitoring numbers of the final-model rerun (15 Oct 2026), computed from the archived
forecast.npz arrays only (no inference). Same reductions as reporting_20261013/recompute_reporting_20261013.py,
channels_ext_20261013/ext_report.py and table_metrics_20261013/inverse_metrics.py:
  ensemble-mean (or MAP) field vs FE truth at ten years over reservoir rows 16:144 -- RMSE, MAE, relative L2;
  near-well RMSE / MAE / relative L2 within the 6 m support of the producer (T) and injector (p);
  log10 k RMSE / MAE / relative L2; raw P5-P95 width of the block-averaged well responses (not for MAP).
Self-consistency: field and log10 k RMSE must reproduce runs/operator_final_20261015/monitoring/report.json.
Output (next to this file): inference_numbers.json (per reservoir, 24-reservoir and first-six means and sample SD),
inference_numbers.csv (long format). Usage: python inference_numbers.py [--nuts]
NUTS updated 19 October 2026 to all 24 fixed reservoirs (96 completed chains); test_16 fails convergence criteria and remains included. See nuts_summary_24.json and nuts_diagnostics_24.csv.
